svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: cost per 100 kilometres
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. A made-up current model at 160 dollars over a made-up 400 kilometres costs 40 dollars per 100 kilometres. A made-up previous-season model at 90 dollars over the same made-up distance costs 22 dollars and 50 cents per 100 kilometres. The distance is not a replacement rule.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: cost per 100 km
The 400 km lifespan is made up. It is not a rule for when to replace a shoe.
$160 over 400 km is $40 per 100 km. $90 over 400 km is $22.50 per 100 km.
If the cheaper shoe is abandoned early, redo the division with the wears you got.
No model is named. Replace on wear signs, not on this made-up distance.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
